title: OMUSOLO OGUSASULWA KU BIDDUKA - Ekitongole ekivunaanyizibwa ku musolo mu Uganda
text:
| SN | Ekika ky’ekidduka | Omusolo ogusasulwa buli mwaka ku buli ttani oba omusaabaze |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Boda boda | 20,000 buli musaabaze |
| 2 | Ebidduka ebiri waggulu wa ttani 2 | 50,000 buli ttani |
| 3 | Tuleera | 50,000 buli ttani |
| 4 | Ebidduka ebisaabaza abantu (PSVs) | 20,000 buli musaabaze |
| 5 | Bbaasi | 20,000 buli musaabaze |

headers: Omusolo ogusasulwa buli mwaka ku buli ttani oba omusaabaze
